kind: documentation-and-current-source-check; not a new Lean run

checks.fragment_scope: Path resolution checked; historical heading anchors not re-audited

review_model_scope: Separated native AI agents; not external human review

executions.lean_this_review: NOT RUN; prior D3 kept with original source, time and trust boundaries

base_repository_validator.status: Final immutable candidate validation and resulting-main identity are recorded in the adopting PR; not pre-claimed here.

manifest_policy: FILE_MANIFEST.json lists all package payload files including this validation; excludes itself to avoid self-reference. CURRENT.md has its own external-target entry.
